title: The coca leaf: tradition, law and drug trafficking
goal: Report what the government, the United Nations and coca growers say about the coca leaf, using según and reporting verbs.
grammar: reported statements and citing sources with según

items: I can say who says what about the coca leaf, using *según* and *dice que*.
I can tell the difference between the coca leaf and cocaine as people present it.
I can name the main words for coca and its traditional use in Spanish.
